trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then strangers and collectibles, then the counted grinds. The story is the short part; the cleanup is where the hours go, so budget roughly 60-100 hours in total and use this guide's checklist to see what is left at a glance.
steps: Clear every story trophy in stages 1-2
Finish strangers, activities and collectibles in stage 3
Grind stunts, races and challenges in stage 4
Check the in-game 100% tracker before the final push
sources: Exophase — official GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (grade, progress targets)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss: finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission that introduces Lucia, Jason and Leonida. It is a guided tutorial — driving, moving on foot and the fishing beat the mission is named after — so just follow the prompts to the mission-complete screen and the trophy pops.
steps: Start a new game and play Gone Fishing
Follow the tutorial prompts as they appear
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen
sources: Exophase — official GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (grade, progress targets)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 1 by playing its story missions in order. Side activities are optional and nothing in the chapter locks you out — a failed mission can simply be retried from the pause menu. Use the chapter to learn Vice City's streets, because later chapters send you back over them.
steps: Play each Chapter 1 story mission in order
Retry any failed mission from the pause menu
The trophy pops on the chapter-complete card

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 2. The chapter opens more of Leonida and brings in new contacts; keep following the story markers and the trophy follows. As you play, note where stranger markers appear — they stay available after the story, which matters for the cleanup stages.
steps: Play each Chapter 2 story mission in order
Note stranger markers that appear for later
The trophy pops on the chapter-complete card

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 3. The story now ranges across Vice City and the wider state, missions get longer and the drives between them grow, so keep a fast car stored in a garage. Nothing in this chapter is missable — complete it and the trophy pops.
steps: Play each Chapter 3 story mission in order
Keep a fast, sturdy car in your garage
The trophy pops on the chapter-complete card
sources: Exophase — official GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (grade, progress targets)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Expect the hardest shootouts of the story so far — buy armour and ammo before the big set-pieces, fight from cover, and use Combat Focus when the game offers it. The trophy pops on the chapter-complete card.
steps: Play each Chapter 4 story mission in order
Stock armour and ammo before set-piece missions
Fight from cover and use Combat Focus
sources: Exophase — official GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (grade, progress targets)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold and unmissable: complete the final mission. Before starting it, make a manual save — the finale is the natural moment to finish any last story-linked cleanup, and the choice-flavoured trophy (Actions Speak Louder) sits close to the end of the story. Play the finale through to the credits and the trophy pops.
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission
Clear any story-linked side content first
Play the final mission through to the credits
sources: Exophase — official GTA VI trophy list (name, description, grade); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (grade, progress targets)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable story-mission trophy: complete Breakfast Run. It unlocks by playing through the chapters, so just follow the story markers until it appears and finish it. No special preparation is needed; if you fail, retry it from the pause menu.
steps: Follow the story markers until Breakfast Run unlocks
Play the mission through to the end
Retry from the pause menu if you fail

trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist unlocks
Clear its setup beats, then the main job
Stock armour before the job's finale

Follow the mission objectives to the end
Retry from the pause menu if you fail

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold, and the last trophy most players will earn: attain 100% completion. The in-game Stats screen shows the 100% checklist — story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the counted grinds (stunts, races, challenges). Work through this guide's roadmap stage by stage; the exact 100% requirements were not fully confirmed at launch, so treat the in-game tracker as the source of truth.

Clear the counted grinds (stunts, races, challenges)

Chain near-misses and airtime on highways
Repeat until 250 — it stacks across all play

Do it after the story, when you own the full weapon set.

Practice the track once before racing it
Win at every location — a finish is not enough
